$comment: Context-quality budget (ADR-0052, context-engineering PR1). Enforced deterministically by scripts/check-context-quality.mjs (`npm run check:context-quality`), which drives the keiko-workflows lane allocator over a FIXED corpus of long agentic-coding-session scenarios (scripts/lib/context-quality-corpus.mjs). The corpus uses NO clock and NO Math.random (seeded LCG + fixed fixtures) and repo-evidence is built through the REAL searchText/readExcerpt path, so every preservation/budget/injection/redaction/path-free/determinism metric is byte-reproducible across runs; the harness asserts this itself (the `determinism` metric, which evaluates the corpus twice and requires deep-equal). The ONLY nondeterministic value is the measured assembly latency, gated by a GENEROUS soft ceiling (a multiple of the observed local p95), never an exact match. HARD invariants below are strict (=0 or =1); SCAFFOLDED metrics deferred to later PRs are gated leniently now and tightened in PR2/PR3/PR4. Fields prefixed with `$observed` are recorded baselines the evaluator IGNORES.
$comment_rehydration: MEASURED + LOAD-BEARING (PR2). The harness builds a ContextProvenanceRef for every EXCLUDED meta-backed repo-evidence item, calls buildCompactionRecords, then runs the REAL readExcerpt round-trip per excluded repo-file ref against the corpus fs; rehydrationReadiness = (resolved AND not-invalidated) / (excluded repo-file items). The corpus now deterministically evicts >= 2 low-scored meta-backed repo-evidence items (their lane text IS the raw excerpt so the per-excerpt contentHash matches the fresh read). A NON-VACUOUS GUARD fails the gate if the excluded-repo-file denominator (summary.measured.excludedRepoFiles) is < 2, so the metric can never silently become vacuous again.
$comment_compaction: MEASURED + LOAD-BEARING (PR2). For every excluded repo-file item, compactionPreservation requires it to appear in some compaction record's sourceSpans AND carry a matching ContextInvalidationKey by scopePath. Nothing about this metric is deferred — it is measured end-to-end over the builder output.
$comment_invalidation: MEASURED hard-boolean (PR2). One excluded repo-file ref is rehydrated against a SECOND fs snapshot whose file body is deterministically mutated; the gate requires the result to carry invalidated===true. The mutation never touches the corpus fs used for the fresh-read checks.
$comment_tool_shaping: MEASURED + LOAD-BEARING as of PR3 (ADR-0054 D9). evaluateToolObservationShapingFidelity runs the REAL keiko-workflows shapers (shapeCommandObservation/shapeTestObservation/shapeSearchObservation) over deterministic fixtures (a truncated+secret+injection command, a clean command, a failing VerificationResult, and a real searchText SearchResult with > MAX_TOP_RANGES candidates) and scores a fixed set of pass/fail fidelity checks: fidelity = passed/total, gated >= 0.9. Two hard-boolean sub-invariants are surfaced separately and REQUIRED: shapingRedactionClean (no secret survives ANY serialized shaped field) and shapingInjectionFlagged (the injection fixtures are flagged with hasCriticalInjectionSignal). HONEST LIMITATION: per-test failingTestNames and pass/fail/skip counts are NOT asserted because the live VerificationResult (keiko-contracts/verification.ts) exposes no per-test data — those counts live step-level on VerificationReport, and the test shaper honestly emits empty names + zero counts rather than inventing them. That fidelity sub-dimension is out of scope until a richer test-result producer exists.
$comment_token_accounting: MEASURED hard-boolean (Issue #1766). The harness runs the real allocator over every fixed scenario with a calibrated ContextProfile and requires diagnostics to report source=calibrated, at least one representative item count to differ from fallback accounting, and every allocated lane token total to match countContextTokens under the calibrated profile.
$comment_pr4: MEASURED + LOAD-BEARING (PR4-W4, ADR-0055). These six hard-boolean flags gate the chat-history COMPACTION SPLICE end-to-end by driving the REAL keiko-server conversationForGatewayWithCompaction (exported via the package barrel) over a deterministic chat-history corpus (scripts/lib/context-quality-corpus.mjs buildChatHistoryFixtures): a budget-pressure oversized fixture (slow path), a 30-message short-turn fixture that is budget-safe even though it exceeds MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES (fast path), a 24-message session AT the MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES threshold (fast path), and a sub-24 session. chatLongSessionCompaction asserts the budget-pressure invariant set: a validated ContextCompactionRecord is present, messages[0] remains the system message, messages[1] is the role:'user' summary segment (ADR-0055 refined D3), the LATEST user instruction survives VERBATIM, and the dropped early secret plus durable instruction marker are NOT verbatim (redacted/digested). chatManyShortBudgetSafeUnchanged asserts that many short turns do NOT compact merely because the count exceeds 24 when they still fit the effective input budget. chatCurrentInstructionPreserved isolates the milestone headline AC ('budget-pressure sessions compact without losing current user instructions'). chatShortSessionByteIdentical asserts the threshold-fast-path remains byte-identical to conversationForGateway(short). chatNoProfileUnchanged asserts the fallback DEFAULT_CONTEXT_PROFILE full budget-safe projection with no compaction record. chatNoProfileOverflowCompaction asserts the no-profile oversized pressure path also compacts with the same deterministic provenance and redaction guarantees. The companion `chatCompactionLatencyP95Ms` soft gate times the real budget-pressure slow path separately from allocator latency, so the new budget-based compaction algorithm cannot regress through repeated redaction/tokenization/summary construction work. HONEST COVERAGE SPLIT: the GROUNDED single-source AC5 wire byte-identity (buildGroundedGatewayMessages with vs without ContextProfile) AND the grounded contextBudget diagnostics observer are NOT re-asserted by this harness; they are covered by the keiko-server UNIT tests (packages/keiko-server/src/grounded-context-diagnostics.test.ts). This gate owns the CHAT-history compaction splice; the grounded path is owned by those unit tests.
$comment_latency: SOFT ceiling at ~10-50x the observed local p95 so it catches an algorithmic regression in allocateContext without flaking on CI machine variance. Observed values recorded in $observed* fields after a local run; the evaluator ignores the $observed* fields.
